[Turn 5] The Shadow Brokers are a group of hackers who have released a series of cyber espionage tools and documents, often obtained through illegal means, to the public. They are known for their leaks of sensitive information and cyber tools, which have had significant impacts on cybersecurity and the global intelligence community.

One of the major leaks by the Shadow Brokers involved the Stuxnet malware, which was a sophisticated computer worm designed to target and damage Iran's nuclear program. Stuxnet was notable for its ability to exploit multiple zero-day vulnerabilities, which are previously unknown security flaws. It was a significant event in the history of cyber warfare
